attchmntText: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Announcing the Piccadily Agro Industries Limited Q2 FY27 Result. ".
voiceSummary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 277.9 crore, representing a 19.4% year-on-year increase. Distillery revenue grew 30.5% year-on-year to INR 271.3 crore, accounting for 97.6% of total revenue. EBITDA increased 9.6% year-on-year to INR 53 crore. The company achieved a maturation capacity of 96,000 barrels against a current fiscal year target of 1,00,000 barrels. The press release was issued on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 during a Board meeting held on 12 November 2026. The consolidated net profit for the quarter was Rs. 2,328.28 lakhs, with basic earnings per share at Rs. 2.40. For the half year, the consolidated net profit stood at Rs. 4,458.53 lakhs, with basic earnings per share at Rs. 4.53. Total revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 27,788.73 lakhs, while half-year revenue was Rs. 54,839.07 lakhs. The Board also approved the balance sheet as of 30 September 2026, showing total assets of Rs. 1,73,046.96 lakhs. The financial results were reviewed by Chartered Accountants Rattan Kaur & Associates.

attchmntText: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet and Conference Call Schedule
voiceSummary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited will host a conference call on November 16, 2026, at 3:00 P.M. to discuss financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The live webcast registration link is available at www.piccadily.com. The transcript and recording of the call will be uploaded to the same website subsequently.
